tspan.tspan: India’s inflation fell to 0.25% in October 2025, the
Year‐on‐year change in consumer prices, every month from January 2014 to December
2025, coloured by where it sits against the Reserve Bank’s target band of 2% to 6%.
Source: MOSPI (CPI, base 2012, All‐India combined); RBI
The RBI’s inflation target is 4%, with a band of 2% to 6%, in force since August 2016. Dashed cells: April
and May 2020, when MOSPI published no rate.
